verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a model-hosting and inference platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a user-selectable storage region or residency control. The only region-related material describes Baseten's own active-active multi-cluster rerouting, which is platform-managed placement rather than customer choice of data location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
